Description: In the staircase area, Rupert Galley recalls memories related to a piano piece. After mentioning Amelia, he collapses and dies amid thunder.
Location: Study（Study）
Key Information:
  - In the background, an automatically playing piano piece continues.
  - Rupert Galley explicitly recalls the connection between the piano piece and Amelia.
  - Rupert says he has heard this piece before, but only now realizes where it came from.
  - Rupert says Amelia seemed to disappear suddenly, yet no one noticed this fact.
  - Rupert judges the situation is “a bit creepy/weird,” and says he plans to ask someone about it.
  - Then thunder occurs (someone dies); Rupert Galley collapses on the spot and dies.
  - The recorder notes this death does not present typical case characteristics and must be investigated alongside other nodes.
Characters:
  [鲁伯特·嘉利（Rupert Galley）] Person No. 12, a member of the Galley family.
    · Alone in the staircase area, recalling memories related to the piano piece.
    · Explicitly names Amelia and links her to the piano performance.
    · Mentions the abnormal phenomenon that Amelia’s “disappearance” went unnoticed by others.
    · Collapses and dies on the spot after thunder (someone dies).
